item.title: Chest Labels
item.description: Chest Labels is a QoL mod for Core Keeper available on mod.io. Labels chests with icons or names — organize warehouse storage at a glance. What it does Labels chests with icons or names Organize a warehouse at a glance Works with vanilla storage blocks How to install In the main menu, open Mods → Browse (mod.io) and search for the mod, then Subscribe. Restart the game and enable the mod in the Mods menu.

item.title: CK QOL
item.description: CK QOL is a QoL mod for Core Keeper available on mod.io. 11-in-1 QoL pack: wider crafting range, quick stash (Ctrl+A), no death penalty, quick eat/recover/summon hotkeys, shift-click transfer, auto-unlock chests and wormhole map teleport.
